For the measures the 'Find' actions don't show, such as a hospital's readmission rates or a nursing home's inspection citations. No API key required.

parameters.description: Only rows whose column holds this value, ignoring case, such as state = MA. Every pair must match.

parameters.description: More conditions, one to a line: a column, a comparison and a value. Comparisons are =, <>, <, <=, >, >=, contains, starts with, like (% for any text), in and not in (values separated by commas) and between (two values joined by 'and'). Every column holds text, so < and > compare text: use in for ratings, and dates written YYYY-MM-DD compare correctly.

description: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services' Provider Data Catalog: the data behind Medicare's Care Compare. Find hospitals, nursing homes, home health agencies, hospices, dialysis facilities and doctors by place, name, specialty and star rating; get a hospital or nursing home by CCN with its ratings, staffing and penalties, or a clinician by NPI with their locations, affiliations and MIPS score; or search, query and count any of its 240 datasets. Where the NPI Registry says who a provider is, this adds how Medicare rates them. No account or API key required.
